'Ghost: Yoru no Hate' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Song, Main Trailer
The official website for the Ghost: Yoru no Hate original anime movie unveiled additional cast, staff, a second key visual (pictured right), the theme song, and main trailer on Tuesday. The movie is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters on February 11, 2027. The movie was previewed at Sitges Film Festival on October 9 and at Animation Is Film Festival on October 17. Cast Bora: Takeo Ootsuka ([Oshi no Ko]) Ahab: Kazuhiro Yamaji (Shuumatsu no Walküre) Structure: Yuuki Shin (Tokyo Revengers)...
